page-title: Patrick Lessa | Data Scientist & Full Stack Developer
meta-description: Patrick Lessa - Data Scientist & Full Stack Developer. 8+ years turning data into decisions, production pipelines, and AI solutions — end to end.
hero-description: From data and AI modeling to product in production — 8+ years solving problems end to end with Python, SQL, LLMs, and React.
about-p1: I'm a Data Scientist & Full Stack Developer with over 8 years of experience turning multi-source data into business decisions, production pipelines, executive dashboards, and GenAI solutions for companies and government agencies.
about-p2: I work end to end — from problem modeling to delivery — with Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, Docker, Spark, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, plus applied experience with LLMs, RAG, and embeddings. I build from the backend (Python, Flask, APIs) to the frontend (React).
about-p3: I'm pursuing a PhD in Business Administration at UFSC and I'm the founder of Xplore Dados, where I build a RAG-based research assistant with multi-LLM orchestration. Highlights include an 85% reduction in data preparation time, 100+ BI dashboards, and solutions that supported strategic decisions at a global level.
exp-mouts-1: Architect and maintain end-to-end production data pipelines with Apache Airflow and Docker, orchestrating daily ingestion, transformation, and delivery of multi-country market and valuation data.
exp-mouts-2: Automated ingestion of 14 SharePoint and SQL sources, reducing monthly data preparation from 6 hours to 45 minutes.
exp-mouts-3: Delivered executive risk dashboards for LATAM operations in under 30 days, later scaled to a global rollout — supporting board-level decisions.
exp-mouts-4: Modeled analytical layers in Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, Spark notebooks) with star schema and per-country RLS; migrated the backend from SharePoint Lists to Azure SQL.
exp-td-1: Led development of intelligence centers for strategic public agencies, including the Ministry of Education.
exp-td-2: Contributed to delivering over 100 BI dashboards in ~15 months, defining indicators, datasets, and reporting logic that became the source of truth for stakeholders.
exp-td-3: Strategic data structuring for the Brazilian Space Agency.
exp-td-4: Created the Sebrae Startups Observatory, focusing on innovation ecosystem analysis.
exp-feesc-1: Mapped and instrumented 363 institutional processes in 2 months, exposing operational gaps and creating an analytical baseline.
exp-feesc-2: Developed over 20 strategic KPIs for the Distance Education (EaD) area.
exp-feesc-3: Structured and automated 10 manual spreadsheets, reducing time from weeks to days.
exp-informal-1: Conducted market research to identify trends and customer needs.
exp-informal-2: Developed marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
exp-informal-3: Created segmented campaigns based on data and market insights.
edu-masters-focus: Branding, Mixed Methods Research, Web Scraping, Factor Analysis
edu-bachelors-focus: Consumer Behavior, Power BI, Market Research
